data.content:
I drafted and sent four disputes with your approval. I held one weak case until you can find its ticket, and I skipped the rest.

**Sent**
| Case | Amount | Win chance | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-51152 | $28.40 | 90% | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. |
| DD-51131 | $19.00 | 77% | The ticket lists Chicken Momo (Steamed). Handoff took 3 minutes. |
| DD-51115 | $17.50 | 70% | The ticket lists Jhol Momo. Handoff took 3 minutes. |
| DD-51123 | $14.25 | 82% | The ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried). Handoff took 4 minutes. |

- **Limits of the evidence:** A ticket shows what was prepared, not what went in the bag, and each dispute says so.
- **Repeat claims:** The same customer account made 3 claims this period (DD-51123, DD-51131 and DD-51140). I left that out of the disputes so they state facts only and don't comment on the customer.
- **Wording check:** Three drafts failed the wording check because "applied" contains the flagged string "lied". The writer reworded them and they passed.

**Memory lessons**
- **DD-51115:** I relied on the lesson "doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1] won". Two of the three past cases with this pattern won. The loss involved a side item not itemised on the ticket, which doesn't apply because Jhol Momo is on the ticket.
- **DD-51123:** The same lesson, "Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won", only partly matches. This case also has a repeat-claimant count.
- **DD-51152:** The ticket omits the claimed item, so the past cases don't match. I didn't rely on them.
- **DD-51131:** This is a wrong-item claim and there is no similar history, so no lesson applied.

**Needs your action**
- **DD-51102 ($46.80, 35%):** The order ticket for the Chicken Momo Party Tray isn't on file. Please send a photo of it. With a ticket I can re-score the case and draft a dispute if it supports one. This is your largest deduction.

**Skipped or not examined**
- **DD-51171 ($11.00, 15%):** I recommend skipping it.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** The deadline passed 11 days ago.
- **DD-51140 ($13.75) and DD-51160 ($9.50):** Both sit at 60%. I didn't check them because I only examine the top five cases. I can review them if you want.

The next deadline is 2026-11-24, 10 days away. The case notes are in `/plan.md`. I'll record each outcome and a short lesson when you tell me how the disputes turn out.
